svg.title: V2 stateful execution: separate prefill, append and decode commands
svg.desc: PREFILL and DECODE are two views of the same current SoC hardware; one host job is active at a time. PREFILL reads paired K/V for 16 tokens in both physical KV groups, then loads Q per serial head. Completed K/V pairs can supply prefill compute before valid sequence metadata is published at child completion. Prefill token sketches show the resulting valid logical positions after publication. DECODE loads only Q and reads committed resident K/V without modifying the cache. Its token sketch shows an L16 example; supported host decode lengths are 16, 17 and 18, at absolute query position L minus 1. Q0/Q1 share KV0 and Q2/Q3 share KV1. Four query heads are scheduled serially on one reused 16 by 16 systolic array for QK and PV; online softmax and normalization are summarized within the compute engine. Results remain owned in the child result buffer, are packed and sent through AXI output write DMA. Successful host DONE and enabled success IRQ wait for source retirement, the final accepted OKAY B response and no outstanding writes. ACK releases completed job ownership; it does not start computation or clear IRQ. A separate APPEND inset shows one new K/V token per group, with position L provisional during stores and valid only after complete pairs in both groups permit atomic L plus 1 publication. APPEND performs no Q load, compute or output writeback; it reaches DONE and enabled success IRQ after child completion and also requires host ACK. Appending to the L16 example produces L17. Logical token positions do not depict SRAM banks or storage geometry. HEAD_DIM is 16 or 64; cache capacity is 64. CLEAR invalidates metadata, not SRAM bits. Fatal AXI errors require common DUT and endpoint reset; external writes already completed are not rolled back. Arrows summarize routing and job lifetime, not simultaneous execution or port-level wiring.
svg.text: One active host job at a time · PREFILL / APPEND / DECODE are separate commands
Load K/V, then Q per head
Load Q only; no K/V append
Shared compute engine · 4 serial Q heads
One reused 16 × 16 array (QKᵀ + PV) · softmax + normalize
No Q load, compute or writeback
New slot L stays provisional until publication (L = 16 → 17 shown).
Two physical KV groups retain state across healthy jobs + ACK
Logical token positions, not SRAM banks. IRQ clear is separate from ACK; CLEAR invalidates metadata.
